name: Seshachal Technologies Limited
about: Seshachal Technologies Limited engages in the development of software solutions for energy, hospitality, solvent oil businesses, and other businesses in India. The company also engages in finding technology problems and solutions. In addition, it provides various services such as digital services, which includes web design and development, e-commerce solutions, CMS websites and portals, web hosting, native and hybrid mobile app, backend and API development, business intelligence tools, monitoring systems, enrollment applications, multi-system integrations, design consulting, database administration, server administration and other, and maintenance services; and cloud migration. Further, the company provides network services such as wimax, wireless wi-fi, telecom, transmission and connectivity, managed services, enterprise solutions, and value added platforms; and consulting services includes staff augmentation, contract and permanent staffing, recruitment process outsourcing, training and development, talent hub, and executive search. Seshachal Technologies Limited was formerly known as Javelin Technologies Limited and changed its name to Seshachal Technologies Limited in October 2007. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
